{{Quote|You, Kazuda and Griff, are intruders to our home. We lost many of our people in your attack, including our healer. For this, you will face punishment.|The Aeosian queen|audio=AeosianHealer-TheNewWorld.flac|<ref name="The New World" />}}
An [[Aeosian]] '''healer''' hailed from a [[Unidentified Aeosian village|village]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]]<ref name="The New World" /> [[Aeos Prime]].<ref name="No Place Safe" /> By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the healer and many other Aeosians were [[Death|killed]] when the [[First Order]] [[Attack on Aeos Prime|attacked]] the village.<ref name="The New World" />

That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[pilot]]s [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Griff Halloran]] visited Aeos on a scouting mission, hoping to determine if Aeos would be a suitable world for their home, the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. However, the Aeosians and their [[Unidentified Aeosian Queen|queen]] captured the pair believing they were First Order intruders due to the looming presence of the nearby ''Colossus'', blaming them for the healer's death. The queen ordered the two pilots to be [[Diet|fed]] to the [[krakavora]]—[[Water|aquatic]] creatures on Aeos—as punishment, despite the pair's protests and offers to give the [[Homeworld|natives]] medicine to help their wounded. Eventually, after Xiono and Halloran proved their intent to help the Aeosians, the queen agreed to let the ''Colossus'' seek refuge on Aeos.<ref name="The New World" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aeosian healer was first mentioned in "[[The New World]],"<ref name="The New World" /> the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 12]], [[2020]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
